dedupe_keys.name: per and polyfluoroalkyl substances pfas concentrations in the upper danube catchment integrated dataset from h2020 project promisces case study 2

description: Liu, Meiqi and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The collection combines approximately eighteen months of monitoring with external observations of thirty-two PFAS. It covers river water, bank-filtered and other groundwater, landfill leachate, runoff, wastewater-treatment influent/effluent and industrial discharges from the Danube source to Budapest. Vienna and Budapest bank-filtration sites receive particular attention. Some external names and locations are anonymised. The current version supplies structured CSV files; its former Access component was removed, and two substance abbreviations were corrected. The adapted MoRE model explicitly identifies this collection as an input, establishing its role in emission and transport assessment. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
